summary: A plain-text detector finds links, email addresses, dates, street addresses, money amounts and phone numbers as byte ranges. There are no flight or tracking-number detectors, no typed match values, and no pasteboard detection.

features.feature: Match base type and string scanning
features.note: returns kind plus byte range only; no typed payload per match. Six kinds: link, email, date, address, money, phone
http, https and www; used for tappable links in Notes via springboard/src/shell/textarea.rs
local@domain.tld as a byte range; no local-part or domain fields
range only, 7 to 15 digits; no parsed number value
street plus house number, English and Icelandic; no components (city, postcode)
only yyyy-mm-dd and d.m.yyyy; no times, ranges or relative dates
range only: a symbol or code before the amount, or kr and codes after it; no amount or currency value
not built: without a carrier list a flight pattern matches ordinary words such as ID 12
not built: no format separates a tracking number from other ids
the detector could run over pasteboard text but is not wired
detect is reachable from apps and documented

gaps: Typed match values (parsed phone, address parts, date with time, email parts, money amount and currency)
